choices.sthana: Uccha, Saptavargaja, Ojayugma, whole-sign Kendradi, gender Drekkana
choices.saptavargaja: Raman fractional ladder 45,30,22.5,15,7.5,3.75,1.875; compound friendships from natal D1; moolatrikona only D1
choices.saptavargaja_textual_difference: Inspected Sanskrit BPHS27.3 reads integer ladder 45,30,22,15,10,4,2. The Raman fractional ladder is an explicit supporting convention, not claimed as a literal reading of that verse.
choices.dig: Shortest zodiac arc from actual weak cardinal cusp /3; house strength also uses actual angular distance, not house count
choices.kala: Natha, phase, tribhaga, 360/30 mean-year/month epoch, sunrise weekday, equal-hour hora, 45/33/12 Ayana, isolated war
choices.abda_masa: Raman condensed Ahargana, 1827-05-02 Wednesday epoch; not modern civil-year/month lords
choices.cheshta: BPHS27.18 Sun=Ayana, Moon=Paksha; five others classical mean/true midpoint and sighrocca arc
choices.mean_motion: Raman 1900/76E epoch, Surya Siddhanta rates; Venus prose correction .001/year chosen over .0001 table discrepancy
choices.war: Lower numeric sidereal longitude wins, Raman canonical disc values; exact ties/multiple shared wars withheld
choices.drik: BPHS27.19 signed quarter, plus full Jupiter/Mercury superaddition; differs from Raman quarter-only convention
choices.bhava: Sripathi midpoint, lord+angular Dig+Drik+occupancy+rising adjustments; not whole-sign interpretation houses
choices.twilight: Adapter conservatively withholds house outputs when absolute solar altitude <=18 degrees; this is a diagnostic exclusion, not an asserted traditional twilight definition
